guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice has the largest deviations in the digest: latency-90 +867% (z=+173), latency-50 +780%, and CPU +656% (z=+67), while its callee productcatalogservice latency is flat (0.0016 before and after), which points to the fault being local to recommendationservice. Memory rose only +14.8% and there are no error or warning logs, so CPU saturation fits best; the slow traces go through currencyservice and do not include recommendationservice, so they are unexplained and lower confidence.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate recommendationservice CPU usage (e.g. a CPU hog or runaway process in the pod). Then restart the pod or scale out replicas, and raise the CPU limit if the load is legitimate.
